description:
Initech Robotics builds warehouse robots.
Plan and run robot fleet rollouts at customer warehouses, and keep every site safe while the fleet goes live.

lists.content:
• Run deployment programs across customer warehouse sites
  • Coordinate hardware, software and site teams on one plan
  • Write the go-live checklist for each site and sign it off

• 4+ years of program or project management
  • Experience with hardware, logistics or warehouse operations
  • Must hold a current driver's licence
  • Comfort working on customer sites
